_note: Current provisional FATES-005C candidate. This is a post-reassessment bounded governed vertical, not a replacement for historical Stage-A evidence and not a seal.

adrasteia.role: portable runtime contracts, canonical context, receipt and binding representation

ananke.role: authenticated authority, policy, content preflight and signed authority receipt

mnemosyne.role: strict authenticated receipt and source-bound memory admission

horae.role: composition, capability reduction, governed lifecycle and dispatch gating

moirae-code.role: controlled host/guest-shaped request envelope; no direct provider execution in this vertical

integration.role: non-recursive exact control/operation identity; deliberately untagged and not claimed as a moving branch head

candidateOperation.name: governed.memory-admission
candidateOperation.effectModel: deterministic in-process controlled sink dispatched only after ADMITTED
candidateOperation.freshness: local fixed-clock receipt validity; expired evidence fails closed

securityBinding.operationBinding: canonical SHA-256 over operation ID, correlation, authenticated caller, acting agent, tenant, workspace, project, action, source/memory resource, destination and input digest
securityBinding.freshnessPolicy: Ananke/Mnemosyne receipt validation uses issuedAt/expiresAt under the bounded local clock; expired or malformed authority is rejected
securityBinding.replayPolicy: IDEMPOTENT_SAME_EFFECT for an identical operation binding; changed payload or scope is rejected and receipt reuse is rejected
securityBinding.artifactVerification: Runtime Contracts artifact is SHA-256 verified when materialized; source and artifact identities are recorded separately

notes: FATES-005C current candidate: one bounded in-process governed memory-admission vertical across the five runtime peers. Adrasteia source a1c01 is the checked-out 0.6.2 challenge/runtime source; the published 0.6.2 artifact remains bound to its existing release source 6aba. Ananke remains the frozen challenge-compatible authority checkpoint. Horae, Mnemosyne and Moirae Code are exact current development checkpoints. The Integration entry pins the exact tested implementation/control commit on the dedicated feature branch. It is deliberately non-recursive: the final publication commit contains this manifest and is therefore reported separately rather than embedded in itself. The candidate is provisional, unsigned, not production-ready, not security-complete, not Firecracker-accepted and not Qwen-validated.
knownLimits: This candidate proves one bounded in-process operation, not every Fates operation.
Horae, Mnemosyne and related replay state remain process-local; cross-process and power-loss durability are not established.
The controlled effect is an in-memory sink and does not prove external exactly-once effects.
The Moirae path is host/guest-shaped but no Firecracker guest launch, jailer boundary, vsock-only proof or VM escape proof was performed.
Host credential custody, network isolation and direct-provider impossibility require the future Linux/KVM acceptance environment.
Ananke metadata still advertises a stale 0.4.0 Runtime Contracts range in one adapter while its actual dependency is 0.6.2; this candidate records the mismatch without changing Ananke.
Peer package installs do not all advertise one identical Runtime Contracts artifact URL; the bounded smoke proves API-level compatibility for this operation only.
No Qwen/model integration, external provider call, release tag, seal or production-readiness claim is made.
